correctness.rationale: For any full-support distribution, variance zero of a continuous observable entails a universal identity. Evaluating all such identities on a product state and translated two-site maximally entangled states reduces them to exact kernels of circulant cut matrices. Adjacent pairs have Fourier factor 1+z^k; when 2k<n and this vanishes, pairs at separation k+1 have nonzero factor 2. At 2k=n the exact nullspace consists of antisymmetric complementary modes. Standalone finite checker independently reconstructs 24-replica Haar covariance and verifies finite ranks; it is not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Exact number of independent interval purity coordinates is a natural structural invariant of planar-uniformity constraints and determines when a covariance singularity is a fundamental Schmidt-complement identity rather than an ensemble artifact. It applies to every full-support ensemble and admits an explicit finite set of Bell-pair witness states, providing a concrete experimental characterization distinct from Haar scalar moment tables. No downstream lower eigenvalue or sample complexity claim is made.
